sources.text: Welcome to the CMRR STAR Research Group at UC San Diego! Led by Professor Paul H. Siegel , the Signal Transmission And Recording (STAR) group focuses on signal processing, information and coding theory, with particular interest toward digital data storage systems and wireless communications. We are part of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at UC San Diego . Some group members also participate with the Center for Memory and Recording Research (CMRR) and the Center for Wireless Communications (CWC) . All STAR Doctoral students are in the area of Communication Theory and Systems .
